generatedConcept.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: preproduction art direction for an ORIGINAL playable cozy 3D lofi gaming-room game, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: Reimagine the attached original 2D cartographer room as a modern, lived-in 3D gaming and study room. Retain the brown-haired character's friendly silhouette, teal clothing palette, books, small map motif, plants, and warm welcoming personality, translated into a contemporary room. This is an original design: use the general cozy focus-game genre, do not copy Spirit City characters, assets, room arrangement, logos, or interface.
Scene/backdrop: One small believable room viewed from a fixed three-quarter elevated camera through cutaway front walls. A wooden gaming desk is the clear focal point, with two modest monitors, a keyboard, mouse, headphones on a stand, one small PC tower with very restrained teal indicator lighting, and an open notebook. The desk, chair, and adult-sized character must have correct physical proportions and floor contact. The character sits naturally, hands aligned to keyboard and mouse, feet grounded. Leave a readable walking path around the chair.
A rain-streaked window shows a blue-purple night outside. A warm amber practical desk lamp illuminates the desk surface and character hands, with soft physically plausible shadows. Books, a small original framed map, and plants connect this room to the attached original. A small sleeping cat is on a cushion off the walking path. The room is quietly inhabited, not a neon esports showroom.
Style/medium: polished stylized 3D game art, restrained soft-edged low-poly geometry with hand-painted material character, convincing depth, clean silhouettes, cozy warm/cool lighting, practical and achievable for a Unity URP indie game, not photoreal and not pixel art.
Composition/framing: single coherent room scene, desk and seated character large enough to read in a thumbnail, see chair and legs without desk clipping, furniture laid out for actual interaction, scene fills image with no border. Reserve a small calm corner for later game UI but do not draw any UI.
Avoid: text, captions, watermark, brand names, fake game interface, exaggerated bloom, crowded clutter, generic floating cards, overbright RGB, extra people, deformed hands, tiny chair, hovering feet, furniture intersecting the character, copied franchise designs.
This is one art-direction concept illustration, not evidence of a completed 3D implementation.

plannedInputs.prompt: Build a clean low-poly wooden desk from editable geometry, dimensions approximately 1.4m wide, 0.65m deep, 0.74m high, subject to actual character and chair fit. Unobstructed knee clearance; separate tabletop and supports. Produce monitor 0.53m wide with a stable stand. Keep pivots, real unit scale and UV layout explicit. This is authored geometry, not AI mesh generation.

Capture a rights-cleared single adult doing a slow standing stretch beside a chair, full body including feet continuously visible, camera fixed, good even lighting, clear contrast to plain background, no body cropping or occluding furniture. Record native speed. Check current official capture guidelines before upload. Do not synthesize or claim a captured performance when no real source is available.

Implement an isolated Unity 6 URP cozy room scene. Use reviewed native motion clips. A click requests an action through explicit states Idle -> Walk -> Align -> Enter -> Loop -> Exit, with cancellation only at safe boundaries. Match route displacement to root motion, ground feet, and align seated pelvis/hands to real furniture. Keep all in-scene audio/UI controls responsive; browser audio begins only after interaction. Persist notes, volume and weather under ai3d-lofi-room-v1 keys, preserve other project scenes and the old 2D game's storage. Add day/night/rain, desk game/study modes, a simple focus timer. Never silently substitute procedural limb waving for missing clips. Verify with actual play before recording. Final target is browser-first Unity WebGL 2 with WebAssembly. Do not rely on native desktop plugins or filesystem APIs. Show a Play button to unlock audio; local notes and settings persist only in this browser. Stream/select music on demand rather than decoding all tracks at launch. Provide loading progress, fullscreen, mute, error/retry UI and responsive mouse/touch controls. Keep versioned static asset paths and verify the deployed WASM MIME/compression headers.
